projects.lastActivity: Feb 15: Drafted 3 Reddit validation post versions for VoiceInvoice (question format, soft validation, direct pitch) + phased posting strategy. Ready for validation when Jordon approves.

activityLog.description: Feb 15: Drafted 3 Reddit validation post versions for VoiceInvoice (question format, soft validation, direct pitch) + phased posting strategy. Ready for validation when Jordon approves.

Feb 15: Drafted VoiceInvoice landing page copy (hero, problem/solution, pricing, FAQ). Researched validation channels - r/Plumbing, r/electricians, r/HVAC, r/smallbusiness. Found recent thread (1wk old) asking exact question re solo invoicing. Ready for validation posts.

Feb 14 research: Confirmed gap - searched 8 plumbing invoice tools (ServiceTitan, Workiz, Zoho, Tofu, etc). NONE mention voice input. All assume typing on mobile. Voice-to-invoice while driving remains untapped. Drafted tracer bullet concept: VoiceInvoice $5/mo.

Competitor deep-dive: Invoice Fly $52-99/mo, InvoiceCue freemium, Jobber $19+. NONE have voice-to-invoice. Gap validated: no $3-5/mo voice-to-invoice for solo trades exists. Key insight: all assume manual typing/tapping on mobile. Voice input while driving is untapped.

Jobber pricing research: Lite $19/mo (1 user, basic), Core $39-69/mo (solo), Connect/Grow $129-599/mo (teams). Gap confirmed: $3-5/mo voice-to-invoice tool fits well below Jobber Lite. Target users: solo tradespeople who just need voice→invoice, not full FSM suite.

HVAC software landscape research. Market segmented: ServiceTitan (residential high-volume), FIELDBOSS (commercial/ERP), Jobber (small teams/simplicity). Gap: solo tradespeople below Jobber tier. Sera Systems mentioned as "built by plumber himself" with good support - validates founder-domain-expertise thesis. Voice-to-invoice could fit below Jobber.

Medium article validates trades thesis. Top idea: Voice-to-Task for Field Techs - plumbers/HVAC/electricians speak updates while driving, AI parses into invoice line items. Quote: "Most successful micro SaaS 2026 are built by people who understand workflow of plumber/lawyer/florist, not C++." Also: local compliance tracker, ghost kitchen inventory, B2B video repurposer.

Analyzed RockingWeb 1,000 Micro-SaaS Revenue Study. Key data: 70% earn <$1k/mo BUT 95% profitable in 12mo. Winners: Email tools ($4.2k median), Dev APIs ($3.8k). Best pricing: hybrid (sub+usage) = 21% growth. Freemium converts only 3.7%. Single channel focus beats diversification (40% rely on one organic channel). Domain expertise = 2x success rate. AI-native = 2x faster growth.

Researched Startup Stash "7 Boring Micro-SaaS" article. Confirms trades thesis: plumbers/HVAC/inspectors run 6-figure businesses on clipboard+paper, willing to pay for time savings ("get home for dinner"). Pattern: unsexy > hype, painkiller > vitamin. Aligns with our prior trades research.

Researched Superframeworks micro-SaaS analysis. Key data: market $15.7B→$59.6B by 2030 (30% CAGR). 9% MRR lost to failed payments (dunning opportunity). Validation framework: 30 days = landing page + 20 signups + 10-20 interviews. Pattern: hyper-specialized AI tools outperforming generic.
